label: WordArt (contextual tab)
purpose: contextual ribbon tab of the 'WordArt Tools' family; exists only while: a WordArt object is selected. Groups: Text, WordArt Styles, Shadow Effects, 3-D Effects, Arrange, Size. Appeared on the 'wordart' probe.

children.label: Edit Text...
children.tooltip: Edit the text for this WordArt.
children.state_notes: group 'Text'; keytip Alt, J W, E; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Spacing
children.tooltip: Change the spacing between the letters of the text.
children.state_notes: group 'Text'; keytip Alt, J W, A S; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Even Height
children.tooltip: Make all letters exactly the same height, both uppercase and lowercase.

children.label: 3-D On/Off
children.tooltip:
Turn on or off the 3-D effect applied to the shape.

You might want to turn off the 3-D effects temporarily to allow you to edit the shape more easily.
children.state_notes: group '3-D Effects'; keytip Alt, J W, O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Tilt Right
children.tooltip: Tilt the shape to the right.
children.state_notes: group '3-D Effects'; keytip Alt, J W, 7; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Tilt Down
children.tooltip: Tilt the shape forward.
children.state_notes: group '3-D Effects'; keytip Alt, J W, 8; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Position
children.tooltip:
Choose where the selected object will appear on the page.

Text will automatically wrap around the object so that it's still easy to read.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J W, P O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Wrap Text
children.tooltip:
Choose how your text wraps around the selected object.

For example, you can choose to have the text continue around the object or cross right over it.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J W, T W; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Bring Forward
children.tooltip: Bring the selected object forward one level, or bring it in front of all the other objects.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J W, A F; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Send Backward
children.tooltip: Send the selected object back one level, or send it behind all the other objects.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J W, A E; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Selection Pane...
children.tooltip:
See a list of all your objects.

This makes it easier to select objects, change their order, or change their visibility.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J W, A P; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Align
children.tooltip:
Change the placement of your selected objects on the page.

This is great for aligning objects to the margins or the edge of the page. You can also align them relative to one another.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J W, A A; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Group
children.tooltip: Join objects together to move and format them as if they were a single object.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J W, A G; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Rotate
children.tooltip: Rotate or flip the selected object.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J W, A Y; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)
